description: Expandable parent-category card in the budget list. Collapsed: shows icon, name, sub-count, an aggregate progress bar and total. Expanded: reveals editable CategoryBudgetRow children (or the parent as its own row when it has no subs) plus a dashed Add Subcategory button. Tokenized re-skin of the existing categoryGroupCard.

category.description: id, name, color, icon, budget_amount, spent, unverified_count, subcategories[]

onSetBudget.type: (categoryId: string, budgetId: string | null | undefined, amount: number) => void

regions.name: typography.smallBold colors.text (numberOfLines 1)
regions.trailingTotal: aggregate budget in typography.smallBold colors.text, or em-dash in colors.textDark when unbudgeted

expandedBody.noSubs: render parent as its own CategoryBudgetRow

accessibility.label: {name}, {n} subcategories, {budgeted} budgeted, {expanded|collapsed}
accessibility.note: category.color is data-driven and preserved for the icon chip; all chrome uses tokens.

developerNotes: Preserve existing expand state + aggregate math. Only presentation changes.
